tion to treat analysis 48% vs. 22% (p ¼ 0.00,003) (Verma et al., 2000).
A meta-analysis of four studies in Japanese patients with active CD (n ¼ 342) compared treatment using PEN (at least 600 kcal/
day of formula) in addition to Inﬂiximab induction therapy vs. Inﬂiximab monotherapy without dietary restrictions. It found that
the addition of PEN to Inﬂiximab monotherapy resulted in a higher rate of clinical remission (69.4% vs. 45.4%, p < 0.01) which
was sustained at the 1 year follow up (75.4% vs. 49.2%, p < 0.01) (Nguyen et al., 2015). These studies need to be conﬁrmed in
a broader patient cohort to determine the generalizability of this strategy.
